findings.evidence: AppController.isInitialized() is a safe singleton guard; sharedInstance asserts if read before initialization. EnabledAppController.embeddedUpdateId loads and caches the embedded manifest, while the source path does not write persistent app/profile storage.
findings.condition: Check initialized state before singleton access, guard controller type, invoke only the permitted UUID getters, and stop on unexpected type or access failure.

findings.evidence: DevLauncherAppController returns no embedded update in module constants; EnabledAppController uses a different configured path. app.config.js disables Expo Updates in release runtime mode.
findings.condition: Treat Debug UUIDs as capability diagnostics only. For the Release proof, use a recorded Xcode Release build with the existing smoke runtime profile and require the EnabledAppController guard to pass. Do not override configuration.

findings.evidence: Native isEmbeddedLaunch is true only when an embedded update exists and its UUID equals the launched update UUID. The embedded getter can fatal on missing or malformed bundled manifest.
findings.condition: Require both UUIDs non-null and equal; bind that embedded UUID to the exact built app's embedded manifest and JS bundle hash. Run only after normal launch; abort on uncertain LLDB detach or app resumption.

conditions: Wait until max-text UI work is complete before LLDB attach.
Use a finally cleanup path that detaches on success and failure; confirm detach and app resumption; stop if LLDB crashes or detach is ambiguous.
No build/install before Debug capability is proven and this design review passes.
No getConstants, manifest/headers/environment/path/storage inspection, product logging/configuration change, or profile mutation.
UUID equality alone is not source revision, content hash, session pin, or Q13 runtime acceptance.
